text: {"lessons":["A few months of price moves are noisy and do not predict what comes next, so I should avoid reacting to every daily fluctuation.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should set a sensible risk limit and make decisions by a plan rather than by fear after a decline.","I should not hold a losing stock just to avoid admitting a mistake; I should reassess it using its future prospects, not my purchase price."]}
